scope: New host connection checks, complete uncertain-result messages, native download handoff, compatibility-gate recovery, rendered PS4/PS5 connection/native-manager controls and setup. No whole-site coverage claim.
method: Evaluated the actual pure lookup implementation from languages/i18n.js against each generated dictionary. Rendered dashboard() for both consoles and host/manager modes. Exercised real inspectConsoleServices with injected Response fixtures only; no console connections, payload execution or file operations.
